address: 212B/D48 Nguyen Trai Street, Nguyen Cu Trinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, 71014, Vietnam
bio: In addition to regular fish and crustaceans dishes, this legendary restaurant is especially famous for bivalves and sea snails – a plethora of different species are on the menu, many of which are rarely seen elsewhere. The live critters are cooked in traditional Vietnamese condiments with enough seasoning to complement the natural umami without being overpowering. The bustling vibe makes it great for casual gatherings....
